headline: King Von's Ghost in the Machine: Vonnie Brasco & Jammy The Bull
body: DJ Akademiks posts a photo of Vonnie Brasco and Jammy The Bull, asking fans what King Von in heaven would think. The post, shared on September 5, 2026, taps into the late rapper's legacy with a playful nod to his iconic status. With 12K likes and 797 comments, the post has sparked debate about how King Von's spirit might react to current hip-hop culture.
